title: helianthemum apenninum subsp. croceum
intro: Helianthemum apenninum subsp. croceum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and promote overall well-being. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum apenninum subsp. croceum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
